description: Hugging Face provides model and dataset tools. Learn to read model information and use local Datasets and Tokenizers examples without downloading a model or publishing files. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain read a model card before use
Explain make a dataset from a dictionary
learningObjectives: Practise split data for later checks
Practise build a tiny word tokenizer

seo.title: Hugging Face Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Hugging Face with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
